question: For what purpose are the kundukas to be given in this stage of the rite?
premises: Kundukas are mentioned as items to be given.
The stated purpose is sevenfold prosperity.
The instruction is addressed to the beloved.
inference: Kundukas are to be given to bring about sevenfold prosperity.
uncertainties: kundukān may refer to specific ritual vessels or substances
plain_english: And likewise the kundukas, O beloved, for the sake of sevenfold prosperity.
